run_gtest_catch_exceptions_test: run the gtest catch exceptions test suite to verify C++ and SEH exception handling
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest: test the CatchCxxExceptionsTest class to verify C++ exceptions are caught in fixture constructors and test bodies
test_CatchSehExceptionsTest: test the CatchSehExceptionsTest class to verify SEH exceptions are caught when C++ exceptions are enabled or disabled
test_testCatchesCxxExceptionsInFixtureCo: test that C++ exceptions thrown in the test fixture constructor are caught and logged correctly
test_testUnhandledCxxExceptionsAbortTheP: test that unhandled C++ exceptions abort the program when catch_exceptions is disabled
